specialRules.ruleFull: The warband may employ only the hired swords open to every warband, and any dramatis persona who will work for anyone: the Pit Fighter, Warlock, Ogre Bodyguard, Halfling Cook, Imperial Assassin, Tilean Marksman, Johann the Knife, Aenur the Sword of Twilight and Nicodemus the Sage.

Rants are not magic, and reach only members of the warband: never an enemy, an ally or a hired sword. They come into play as spells do, with the difficulty each one prints, and reach as far as the Prophet's Leader rule does, 6" unless that range grows. A rant stays in play until the Prophet suffers a wound or chooses to stop, and only one rant may be in play at a time. A rant's psychological effect works on warband members who are immune to psychology, because it comes from their own belief in the Prophet.

When the Prophet rolls a skill advance he may instead roll for another rant, or lower the difficulty of a rant he has by one. A rant rolled twice is rolled again.

equipmentLists.title: Lunatics and Maimed Ones Equipment List

specialRules.ruleFull: Any warrior within 6" of the Prophet may use his Leadership for a Leadership test.
The Prophet is immune to fear.
The Prophet starts with one rant.
The Bleak One is immune to fear.
The Bleak One always moves towards the nearest enemy model he can see, and must advance at least 1" in the movement phase. He need not run or charge.
The Bleak One hates the warriors of every warband he faces, except the Sisters of Sigmar.
The Lunatic is subject to frenzy.

Every member of a Maimed Ones group is crippled the same way. Roll a D6 when the group is made and change the profile of all of them to match.

D6 | Result
1 | Bad legs, back and the like: Movement and Initiative each -1.
2 | Missing arms: Weapon Skill -1. He may use neither two weapons nor a weapon and a shield.
3 | Bad vision or blindness: Ballistic Skill -1.
4 | Infirm: Toughness -1.
5 | Wyrdstone weakness: Strength -1.
6 | Head injuries: unless he is within 6" of a hero he is subject to stupidity.

flags.what: A Mordheimer warband needs at least three models: our templates hold no minimum, so it is not imported.
The PDF has no Special skill column: each hero's lists are written out, so the warband brings no skill group of its own.
The two equipment lists were read from the page's own two columns in the -layout text; the reading order runs them together.

The Prophet's rants are not magic but "come into play in the same way as magic spells", so they are imported as the spell lore Prophetic Rants and he is a caster. His Orator rule gives him one of them at the start.
The Lunatics and Orphans sit under Heroes, so a full warband may hold six heroes: one Prophet, one Bleak One, two Lunatics and two Orphans.
Both henchmen entries are "0+" in groups of 1-5, so neither carries a maximum.
The rant difficulties are 6, 8, 8, 7, 9, 9 in the order the D6 gives them.
